levels.surface: أبو عبد الله محمد بن خالد

notes: «قراءة» (read-out) is a mode of transmission, not a name: left out.
Ali speaks inside the story (قال عليه السلام: نعم يا شيخ), so he is the last link after Ali b. al-Husayn, who is a narrator (named after «عن»).
The grandson's chain runs موسى ← أبيه ← جده ← علي بن الحسين; the father and grandfather are relations.
